**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target) — Section 15.16 Nonsolicitation (p0841).**

- **Already met:** mutual scope ("neither Party"), limited to personnel involved in the development activities, solicitation-only (no no-hire), and a general-advertising carve-out.
- **Failed fallback:** (i) duration ran for the entire Term plus an undisclosed `[***]` tail measured from expiry rather than 12 months from the end of the individual's involvement — unverifiable and potentially in walk-away territory; (ii) no unsolicited-approach carve-out.
- **Redline (validated, ok:true):** two surgical replaces — cap at "twelve (12) months after an employee's involvement in the development activities hereunder ends", and append an unsolicited-approach carve-out to the existing carve-out sentence, keeping all other wording verbatim.
